policies.title: Security Screening
policies.content: All passengers must pass bags through X-ray security screening before entering the paid area. This is mandatory at all stations. Prohibited items include flammable liquids, sharp objects, and pressurized containers.
synonyms: do I need to go through security

policies.title: Real-Name Ticketing
policies.content: Single-journey tickets purchased at vending machines require real-name registration via ID scan. Yikatong card and mobile payment (Alipay/WeChat Pay) do not require ID at point of use.
synonyms: do I need ID to buy a ticket
can I buy ticket without ID

policies.title: Operating Hours
policies.content: Most lines operate from approximately 05:00 to 23:00. First and last train times vary by line and station. During national holidays, some lines extend operating hours.
synonyms: what time does the metro open

policies.title: Food and Drink Policy
policies.content: Eating and drinking are prohibited on trains. Violations may result in a fine. Water bottles may be carried but should not be consumed on board.
synonyms: can I eat on the train

policies.title: Luggage Policy
policies.content: Each passenger may bring one piece of luggage not exceeding 30kg. The combined length, width, and height must not exceed 1.8 meters. Folding bicycles in bags are allowed.

policies.title: Barrier-Free Access
policies.content: Most stations have barrier-free facilities including elevators, tactile paving, and accessible gates. Contact station staff for assistance. Wheelchair users may use designated areas on trains.

policies.title: Lost Property
policies.content: Report lost items to station staff immediately. You can also call the Beijing Metro service hotline at 010-96165. Items are kept at the station lost and found for 30 days.

policies.title: Fare Calculation
policies.content: Fares are distance-based: ¥3 for the first 6km, then ¥1 per additional 6km up to 12km, ¥1 per 10km after 32km. Airport express lines have separate flat fares (¥25 Capital Airport, ¥35 Daxing Airport).

policies.title: Free Transfers
policies.content: Transfers between lines within the Beijing Metro system are free. You only pay one fare for your entire journey based on total distance traveled.
synonyms: do I pay extra to transfer

policies.title: Rush Hour Information
policies.content: Peak hours are 07:00-09:00 and 17:00-19:00 on weekdays. Some busy stations (Xizhimen, Guomao, Dongzhimen, Tiantongyuan) implement flow control during these times, which may cause delays entering the station.

policies.title: Children's Fare
policies.content: Children shorter than 120cm ride free when accompanied by a paying adult (limit 2 free children per adult). Children 120cm and taller pay full fare.

policies.title: Senior Fare
policies.content: Beijing residents aged 65 and above ride free with a Beijing Senior Card (北京老年卡). Non-Beijing residents and visitors aged 65+ pay full fare.
